summary.title: Fixing main.py to print Hello, world!
summary.body: I fixed two bugs that kept `python3 main.py` from running: I changed the import in `main.py` from the nonexistent `greetings` module to `greeter`, and I added the missing colon to `def greet(name)` in `greeter.py`. I then ran the program to confirm it exits cleanly and prints `
